_meta.purpose: Fragment manifest for locale fan-out. Single source of truth for translatable strings.

fields.en: English source text (translators translate THIS; identity round-trip restores it).
fields.count: Exact number of occurrences of the resolved search string in the applicable file(s). Hard-fail on mismatch.
fields.anchor: Optional. Contains exactly one '{}'; search string = left + en + right. Default '{}' (bare).
fields.scope: Which surfaces the key applies to: landing (root/locale index.html), sub (subpage chrome), js (home.js/demo-exif.js injection).
fields.html: true if en contains markup that must survive translation (tag whitelist enforced in validate).
fields.prefill: true if this string is byte-reused from the old EN page, so the old locale translation can prefill it mechanically.
fields.plural: Optional CLDR plural variants for js keys (tp()).
